chunks: From him, from Usman ibn Isa, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
If this matter (Al-Wilayah) was in your hands and you have the capacity that you do not teach this, then do so.

He said, 'And it was so that in his presence were some people, and they mentioned the broadcasting, so he said: Preserve your tongues, you would be honoured, and do not enable the people to sit upon your necks, for you would be disgraced'.

key_terms.قِيَادِ رَقَبَتِكَ: Sitting upon the neck (metaphor for control/subjugation)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of preserving one's tongue and concealing religious status in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In the context of al-Kulayni’s *al-Kumayn* (Concealment), this hadith highlights the strategic prudence of hiding one's religious status or knowledge to avoid political persecution and social humiliation. It underscores the practical wisdom of guarding one's tongue, as public exposure often leads to being 'led by the neck' (qiyad al-raqa) by authorities or rivals, thereby compromising one's dignity and autonomy.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Usman Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘If it was so that this matter (Al-Wilayah) was in your hands and you have the capacity that you do not teach this, then do so’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And it was so that in his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> presence were some people, and they mentioned the broadcasting, so he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Preserve your tongues, you would be honoured, and do not enable the people to sit upon your necks, for you would be disgraced’.
en.sarwar: 14. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) who has said the following: “
When there is something in one of your hands, if you can, do not allow the other hand to know about it.’

The narrator has said that there was a man in his presence and they discussed publicity. The Imam said, ‘Control your tongue and you will find honor and do not allow people to become in control of your neck to humiliate you.’”
